name: After § 30
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: 30a. Recalls that failure to mitigate and adapt to climate change in good time as a result of underinvestment or delayed investments will not only have catastrophic human consequences but will also be much more costly in sheer economic terms, hence running counter to the very purpose of the fiscal rules, which is to support sound public finances; notes that, according to the European Environment Agency, delivering the objectives of the European Green Deal requires additional investments at EU level of at least EUR 520 billion per year; considers that the bulk of these additional investments should come from public sources in order to support a fair and democratic transition;
